newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPI sees steady earnings growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: BPI sees steady earnings growth in 1997.

text.p: Profit growth of Portuguese bank Banco Portugues de Investimento will be steady in 1997 as the group boosts cross-selling of its products, but trading gains will be less than in 1996, its president said.

"We can see a lot of room for improving our commissions and very likely the contribution of trading profits will be lower, so globally we can anticipate a balanced evolution (of profits) compared with 1996," Artur Santos Silva told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
He was speaking after the bank announced a 56 percent increase year-on-year in the bank's 1996 profit to 15.1 billion escudos, below market expectations.
